THIS WP(HC) IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, BY THE PETITIONER,
WHEREIN SHE PRAYS THAT THE HONBLE COURT MAY BE PLEASED TO (i) ISSUE A WRIT IN NATURE OF HABEAS CORPUS SET FREE THE DETENUE BY NAME KRISHNA.M.V WITH IMMEDIATE EFFECT AND (ii) ISSUE A WRIT OR ORDER OR DIRECTION AS THIS HON'BLE COURT DEEMS FIT UNDER THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE, IN THE INTEREST OF JUSTICE AND EQUITY.

Smt. Prema vs The Chief Secretary on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148406985/

This petition has been filed seeking habeas corpus for production of one Krishna M.V.
3.

Learned High Court Government Pleader on instructions submits that aforesaid Mr.Krishna M.V.
has been arrested in connection with Cr.No.281/2022 on 19.03.2023 by Tumakuru Rural P.S, for the offence under Section 420 I.P.C.
It is further submitted that aforesaid Mr.Krishna M.V. has already been produced before the Magistrate.
4. The aforesaid submission of learned High Court Government Pleader is taken on record.
In the result petition is disposed of with a liberty to the petitioner to seek recourse of such remedy as may be available with regard to her grievance, if any.

Sd/-
